I got my FISP coupon this year, so I will put the chemical fertilizer on this maize plot because it gave me a better harvest than my sister-in-law’s unfertilized plot last season. I cannot afford extra bags from the agro-dealer for such a small piece of land, so I will apply what I have carefully and mix it with goat manure from home. I will plant the hybrid seed they gave me at the field day — it fills the granary better than the local maize, though I know I must fertilize it for it to pay off. My children and I will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves; we have no money for chemicals or hired workers, and there is no river or pump here for irrigation.
